newsitem.title: GHANA: Standard Chartered drags down Ghana Bourse index.
newsitem.headline: Standard Chartered drags down Ghana Bourse index.

text.p: The Ghana bourse came down sharply on Wednesday, weighed down by a dilution in the share price of Standard Chartered Bank SCB.GHH, the market report showed.
Satandard lost 470 cedis to 4,830 cedis, down from 5,300 cedis on Monday. The fall was attributed to a share bonus the bank issued on May 9, a bourse official said.

"The bank issued one new share for every 10 held, meaning more shares have been created, which does not increase the value but dilutes it -- in this case by a tenth -- which works out to almost 500 cedis," he added.

As a result, the GSE All-share index lost 3.69 to close at 382.49. Total turnover dipped to 18,750 shares worth 2,828.66 billion cedis, down from 25,600 shares valued at 2,834.08 billion cedis on Monday.
Gainers were Pioneer Tobacco (+24 cedis to 245 cedis), trader Paterson Zochonis (+20 cedis to 220 cedis) and Enterprise Insurance Co (+ 5cedis to 515 cedis).
